This file is a merged representation of a subset of the codebase, containing specifically included files and files not matching ignore patterns, combined into a single document by Repomix.
The content has been processed where line numbers have been added.

================================================================
File Summary
================================================================

Purpose:
--------
This file contains a packed representation of a subset of the repository's contents that is considered the most important context.
It is designed to be easily consumable by AI systems for analysis, code review,
or other automated processes.

File Format:
------------
The content is organized as follows:
1. This summary section
2. Repository information
3. Directory structure
4. Repository files (if enabled)
5. Multiple file entries, each consisting of:
  a. A separator line (================)
  b. The file path (File: path/to/file)
  c. Another separator line
  d. The full contents of the file
  e. A blank line

Usage Guidelines:
-----------------
- This file should be treated as read-only. Any changes should be made to the
  original repository files, not this packed version.
- When processing this file, use the file path to distinguish
  between different files in the repository.
- Be aware that this file may contain sensitive information. Handle it with
  the same level of security as you would the original repository.

Notes:
------
- Some files may have been excluded based on .gitignore rules and Repomix's configuration
- Binary files are not included in this packed representation. Please refer to the Repository Structure section for a complete list of file paths, including binary files
- Only files matching these patterns are included: **/*.cs, **/*.cshtml, **/*.csproj, **/*.sln, **/*.json, **/*.md, **/Dockerfile, **/.dockerignore
- Files matching these patterns are excluded: **/Properties/**, **/wwwroot/**, **/PositiveNews.WebApi/**, **/PositiveNews.Web/**, **/logs/**, **/bin/**, **/obj/**, **/.vs/**, **/.vscode/**, **/TestResults/**, **/*.user, **/*.suo, **/AppPackages/**, **/BundleArtifacts/**, **/dist/**, **/node_modules/**, **/Migrations/**, **/appsettings.Development.json, **/appsettings.Local.json, repomix-output.txt, repomix.config.json, **/*.sql, **/*.csproj
- Files matching patterns in .gitignore are excluded
- Files matching default ignore patterns are excluded
- Line numbers have been added to the beginning of each line
- Files are sorted by Git change count (files with more changes are at the bottom)

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/AppDbContext.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 3: 
 4: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence;
 5: 
 6: public class AppDbContext : DbContext
 7: {
 8:     public AppDbContext(DbContextOptions<AppDbContext> options) : base(options) { }
 9: 
10:     // Identity
11:     public DbSet<Role> Roles => Set<Role>();
12:     public DbSet<User> Users => Set<User>();
13:     public DbSet<UserRole> UserRoles => Set<UserRole>();
14:     public DbSet<UserFeedPreference> UserFeedPreferences => Set<UserFeedPreference>();
15:     public DbSet<UserSourceFilter> UserSourceFilters => Set<UserSourceFilter>();
16:     public DbSet<UserTopicFilter> UserTopicFilters => Set<UserTopicFilter>();
17: 
18:     // Catalog
19:     public DbSet<Topic> Topics => Set<Topic>();
20:     public DbSet<Source> Sources => Set<Source>();
21:     public DbSet<ArticleMetadata> ArticlesMetadata => Set<ArticleMetadata>();
22:     public DbSet<ArticleContent> ArticlesContent => Set<ArticleContent>();
23:     public DbSet<ArticleTopic> ArticleTopics => Set<ArticleTopic>();
24:     public DbSet<IngestionRun> IngestionRuns => Set<IngestionRun>();
25: 
26:     // Community
27:     public DbSet<Comment> Comments => Set<Comment>();
28: 
29:     // Admin
30:     public DbSet<AuditLog> AuditLogs => Set<AuditLog>();
31: 
32:     protected override void OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
33:     {
34:         // Applies all IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> from this assembly.
35:         modelBuilder.ApplyConfigurationsFromAssembly(typeof(AppDbContext).Assembly);
36: 
37:         base.OnModelCreating(modelBuilder);
38:     }
39: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/ArticleTopicConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class ArticleTopicConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<ArticleTopic>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<ArticleTopic> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("ArticleTopics", SchemaNames.Catalog);
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(at => new { at.ArticleId, at.TopicId });
15: 
16:         builder.HasOne(at => at.Article)
17:                .WithMany(a => a.ArticleTopics)
18:                .HasForeignKey(at => at.ArticleId)
19:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
20: 
21:         builder.HasOne(at => at.Topic)
22:                .WithMany(t => t.ArticleTopics)
23:                .HasForeignKey(at => at.TopicId)
24:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
25: 
26:         // Reverse lookup index
27:         builder.HasIndex(at => at.TopicId)
28:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticleTopics_Topic_Lookup");
29:     }
30: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/AuditLogConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: using PositiveNews.Domain.Enums;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 8: 
 9: public class AuditLogConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<AuditLog>
10: {
11:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<AuditLog> builder)
12:     {
13:         builder.ToTable("AuditLogs", SchemaNames.Admin);
14: 
15:         builder.HasKey(al => al.Id);
16: 
17:         builder.Property(al => al.EntityType)
18:                .HasMaxLength(50)
19:                .HasConversion<string>();
20: 
21:         builder.ToTable(t => t.HasCheckConstraint(
22:             "CK_Audit_Entity", "[EntityType] IN ('Article', 'Comment', 'User', 'Source')"));
23: 
24:         builder.Property(al => al.ChangedField).HasMaxLength(100);
25:         builder.Property(al => al.OldValue).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
26:         builder.Property(al => al.NewValue).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
27:         builder.Property(al => al.Reason).HasMaxLength(500);
28:         builder.Property(al => al.Note).HasMaxLength(1000);
29:         builder.Property(al => al.CreatedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
30: 
31:         builder.HasOne(al => al.Moderator)
32:                .WithMany()
33:                .HasForeignKey(al => al.ModeratorId)
34:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
35: 
36:         // History lookup index
37:         builder.HasIndex(al => new { al.EntityType, al.EntityId, al.CreatedAt })
38:                .IsDescending(false, false, true)
39:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_AuditLogs_Entity_History");
40:     }
41: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/CommentConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class CommentConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<Comment>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<Comment> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("Comments", SchemaNames.Community);
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(c => c.Id);
15:         builder.Property(c => c.Content).HasMaxLength(2000).IsRequired();
16:         builder.Property(c => c.CreatedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
17:         builder.Property(c => c.IsActive).HasDefaultValue(true);
18: 
19:         builder.HasOne(c => c.Article)
20:                .WithMany(a => a.Comments)
21:                .HasForeignKey(c => c.ArticleId)
22:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
23: 
24:         builder.HasOne(c => c.User)
25:                .WithMany(u => u.Comments)
26:                .HasForeignKey(c => c.UserId)
27:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
28: 
29:         builder.HasOne(c => c.Parent)
30:                .WithMany(c => c.Replies)
31:                .HasForeignKey(c => c.ParentId)
32:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
33: 
34:         builder.HasOne(c => c.Moderator)
35:                .WithMany()
36:                .HasForeignKey(c => c.ModeratedBy)
37:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
38: 
39:         // Thread loading index
40:         builder.HasIndex(c => new { c.ArticleId, c.CreatedAt })
41:                .HasFilter("[IsActive] = 1")
42:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_Comments_Article_Thread");
43:     }
44: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/IngestionRunConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: using PositiveNews.Domain.Enums;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 8: 
 9: public class IngestionRunConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<IngestionRun>
10: {
11:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<IngestionRun> builder)
12:     {
13:         builder.ToTable("IngestionRuns", SchemaNames.Catalog);
14: 
15:         builder.HasKey(ir => ir.Id);
16: 
17:         // Store enum as string for readability and to match the SQL CHECK constraint.
18:         builder.Property(ir => ir.Status)
19:                .HasMaxLength(50)
20:                .HasConversion<string>();
21: 
22:         builder.ToTable(t => t.HasCheckConstraint(
23:             "CK_Ingestion_Status", "[Status] IN ('Running', 'Success', 'Failed', 'Partial')"));
24: 
25:         builder.Property(ir => ir.ItemsFetched).HasDefaultValue(0);
26:         builder.Property(ir => ir.ErrorMessage).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
27: 
28:         builder.HasOne(ir => ir.Source)
29:                .WithMany(s => s.IngestionRuns)
30:                .HasForeignKey(ir => ir.SourceId)
31:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
32:     }
33: }

 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedReader.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 3: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 5: using System.ServiceModel.Syndication;
 6: using System.Xml;
 7: using System.Xml.Linq;
 8: 
 9: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
10: 
11: public class FeedReader : IFeedReader
12: {
13:     private readonly IHttpClientFactory _httpClientFactory; // registered in Infrastructure.DependencyInjection (services.AddHttpClient())
14:     private readonly ILogger<FeedReader> _logger;
15: 
16:     public FeedReader(IHttpClientFactory httpClientFactory, ILogger<FeedReader> logger)
17:     {
18:         _httpClientFactory = httpClientFactory;
19:         _logger = logger;
20:     }
21: 
22:     async Task<XDocument> IFeedReader.ReadFeedAsync(string feedUrl, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
23:     {
24:         var feed = new XDocument();
25:         try
26:         {
27:             _logger.LogInformation("Fetching RSS feed from {FeedUrl}", feedUrl);
28: 
29:             var httpClient = _httpClientFactory.CreateClient("RssFeedClient");
30:             using var response = await httpClient.GetAsync(feedUrl, cancellationToken);
31:             response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
32: 
33:             using var stream = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(cancellationToken);
34: 
35:             feed = XDocument.Load(stream);
36:             return feed;
37:         }
38:         catch (Exception ex)
39:         {
40:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to read feed from {FeedUrl}.", feedUrl);
41:             return feed;
42:         }
43:     }
44: }

================
File: README.md
================
 1: Project Title: "PositiveNews".
 2: 
 3: Level: Educational.
 4: Status: Development.
 5: 
 6: Description: 
 7: A web platform combats "doom-scrolling" by aggregating news from various sources, 
 8: store them, and ranking them based on calculated score. Provides UI for viewing news sorted 
 9: by positivity
10: 
11: The "PositiveNews" features List:
12: 1. Ingestion Engine: Receiving news from various sources.
13: 2. Content Distiller: Get the core news text and short 1min-read summary.
14: 3. Secure Storage: Storing articles, summaries, and metadata in a structured database.
15: 4. Sentiment Assessor: Scoring articles for "positivity" (0.0 to 1.0).
16: 5. Configurable Feed: Public visibility of with a global "positivity" threshold.
17: 6. User Personalization: Authorized users can set their own positivity metrics.
18: 7. Adaptive Reader: Toggle between "Summary" and "Full Article" views.
19: 8. Community Interaction: Leaving and viewing comments on articles.
20: 9. Admin Command Center: Operations for article, sources list editing and comment moderation.
21: 10. Source Filtering: Narrowing the feed to specific trusted publishers (e.g., "Only Reuters").
22: 11. Topic Filtering: Categorizing news by domain (e.g., "Technology," "Health").
23: 12. Topics Sorting: By publication date, or "positivity" score.
24: 13. Automatic logging: Logging of operations with writing to stored text files.

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Connection/ConnectionStringResolver.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.Data.SqlClient;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 3: 
 4: public static class ConnectionStringResolver
 5: {
 6:     public static string Resolve(IConfiguration configuration)
 7:     {
 8:         var defaultConn = configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");
 9:         var altConn = configuration.GetConnectionString("AlternativeConnection");
10: 
11:         if (CanConnectToServer(defaultConn))
12:             return defaultConn!;
13: 
14:         if (CanConnectToServer(altConn))
15:             return altConn!;
16: 
17:         throw new InvalidOperationException(
18:             "Unable to connect to either DefaultConnection or AlternativeConnection.");
19:     }
20: 
21:     private static bool CanConnectToServer(string? connectionString)
22:     {
23:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(connectionString))
24:             return false;
25: 
26:         try
27:         {
28:             var builder = new SqlConnectionStringBuilder(connectionString)
29:             {
30:                 InitialCatalog = "master"
31:             };
32: 
33:             using var connection = new SqlConnection(builder.ConnectionString);
34:             connection.Open();
35:             return true;
36:         }
37:         catch
38:         {
39:             return false;
40:         }
41:     }
42: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/BackgroundJobs/IngestionBackgroundService.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 4: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 5: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 6: 
 7: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.BackgroundJobs;
 8: 
 9: /// <summary>
10: /// A long-running hosted service that periodically triggers the ingestion cycle.
11: /// Interval is configurable via "Ingestion:IntervalMinutes" in appsettings.json.
12: /// </summary>
13: public class IngestionBackgroundService : BackgroundService // ← Implements IHostedService
14: {
15:     private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
16:     private readonly ILogger<IngestionBackgroundService> _logger;
17:     private readonly TimeSpan _interval;
18: 
19:     /// <summary>
20:     /// Initial delay before the first run so the application has time to fully start.
21:     /// </summary>
22:     private static readonly TimeSpan InitialDelay = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(15);
23: 
24:     public IngestionBackgroundService(   // Host Creates instances of IngestionBackgroundService when starts
25:         IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory, // This service added to ASP .NET IoC by default. Needed for creation scope in singleton
26:         ILogger<IngestionBackgroundService> logger,
27:         IConfiguration configuration)
28:     {
29:         _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
30:         _logger = logger;
31: 
32:         // Read interval from appsettings.json
33:         var minutes = configuration.GetValue<int>("Ingestion:IntervalMinutes", 60);
34:         _interval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(minutes);
35:     }
36: 
37:     // THIS METHOD IS CALLED AUTOMATICALLY BY ASP.NET CORE WHEN HOST STARTS
38:     // ASP.NET Core host calls ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken) for each service after app.RunAsync() in programm.cs
39:     // because of BackgroundService implement IHostedService
40:     protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
41:     {
42:         _logger.LogInformation(
43:             "Ingestion Background Service started. Interval: {Interval}. Initial delay: {Delay}.",
44:             _interval, InitialDelay);
45: 
46:         // Wait for the application to fully initialize before the first run.
47:         await Task.Delay(InitialDelay, stoppingToken);
48: 
49:         while (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested) // Infinite loop until app stops
50:         {
51:             try
52:             {
53:                 using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope(); // Create a fresh scope for this cycle
54:                 var ingestionService = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<IIngestionService>();
55: 
56:                 await ingestionService.RunIngestionCycleAsync(stoppingToken);       // ---=== EXECUTE INGESTION ===---
57:             }
58:             catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
59:             {
60:                 _logger.LogInformation("Ingestion Background Service is stopping.");
61:                 break; // ← Exit loop on shutdown
62:             }
63:             catch (Exception ex)
64:             {
65:                 _logger.LogError(ex, "Unhandled exception in ingestion cycle. Will retry after interval.");
66:             }
67: 
68:             // Wait for the configured interval before the next run.
69:             if (!stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
70:             {
71:                 _logger.LogInformation("Next ingestion cycle in {Interval}.", _interval);
72:                 await Task.Delay(_interval, stoppingToken);
73:             }
74:         }
75:     }
76: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Persistence/Configurations/ArticleMetadataConfiguration.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Metadata.Builders;
 3: using PositiveNews.Domain.Constants;
 4: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
 5: 
 6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Configurations;
 7: 
 8: public class ArticleMetadataConfiguration : IEntityTypeConfiguration<ArticleMetadata>
 9: {
10:     public void Configure(EntityTypeBuilder<ArticleMetadata> builder)
11:     {
12:         builder.ToTable("ArticlesMetadata", SchemaNames.Catalog); 
13: 
14:         builder.HasKey(a => a.Id);
15:         builder.Property(a => a.ExternalId).HasMaxLength(300);
16:         builder.Property(a => a.Title).HasMaxLength(500).IsRequired();
17:         builder.Property(a => a.Author).HasMaxLength(300);
18:         builder.Property(a => a.Url).HasMaxLength(1000).IsRequired();
19:         builder.Property(a => a.ImageTag).HasColumnType("nvarchar(max)");
20:         builder.Property(a => a.PublishedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
21:         builder.Property(a => a.IngestedAt).HasDefaultValueSql("sysutcdatetime()");
22:         builder.Property(a => a.PositivityScore).HasColumnType("decimal(5,4)");
23:         builder.Property(a => a.ViewCount).HasDefaultValue(0L);
24:         builder.Property(a => a.LanguageCode).HasMaxLength(10).HasDefaultValue("und");
25:         builder.Property(a => a.RegionCode).HasMaxLength(10).HasDefaultValue("Global");
26:         builder.Property(a => a.IsActive).HasDefaultValue(true);
27:         builder.Property(a => a.SummaryShort).HasMaxLength(2000);
28: 
29:         // Check constraint
30:         builder.ToTable(t => t.HasCheckConstraint(
31:             "CK_Articles_Positivity", "[PositivityScore] BETWEEN 0.0000 AND 1.0000"));
32: 
33:         // Deduplication unique index
34:         builder.HasIndex(a => new { a.SourceId, a.ExternalId })
35:                .IsUnique()
36:                .HasFilter("[ExternalId] IS NOT NULL")
37:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticlesMeta_Source_ExternalId");
38: 
39:         // Feed performance index
40:         builder.HasIndex(a => new { a.LanguageCode, a.RegionCode, a.PublishedAt })
41:                .IsDescending(false, false, true)
42:                .HasFilter("[IsActive] = 1")
43:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticlesMeta_Feed_Date");
44: 
45:         // Source lookup index
46:         builder.HasIndex(a => a.SourceId)
47:                .HasDatabaseName("IX_ArticlesMeta_SourceId");
48: 
49:         // Relationships
50:         builder.HasOne(a => a.Source)
51:                .WithMany(s => s.Articles)
52:                .HasForeignKey(a => a.SourceId)
53:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
54: 
55:         builder.HasOne(a => a.Moderator)
56:                .WithMany()
57:                .HasForeignKey(a => a.ModeratedBy)
58:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.NoAction);
59: 
60:         builder.HasOne(a => a.Content)
61:                .WithOne(c => c.Metadata)
62:                .HasForeignKey<ArticleContent>(c => c.Id)
63:                .OnDelete(DeleteBehavior.Cascade);
64:     }
65: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/ImgTagExtractor.cs
================
  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  5: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  6: using System;
  7: using System.Collections.Generic;
  8: using System.Net;
  9: using System.Text;
 10: using System.Xml.Linq;
 11: 
 12: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 13: 
 14: public class ImgTagExtractor : IImgTagExtractor
 15: {
 16:     private readonly ILogger<FeedReader> _logger;
 17: 
 18:     private static readonly XNamespace MediaNs = "http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/";
 19: 
 20:     public ImgTagExtractor(ILogger<FeedReader> logger)
 21:     {
 22:         _logger = logger;
 23:     }
 24:     public string? ExtractImgTag(XElement itemElement, string contentClean)
 25:     {
 26:         try
 27:         {
 28:             // 1. media:thumbnail (direct child or nested inside media:content)
 29:             var thumbnail =
 30:                 itemElement.Element(MediaNs + "thumbnail") ??
 31:                 itemElement.Element(MediaNs + "content")?.Element(MediaNs + "thumbnail");
 32: 
 33:             if (thumbnail != null)
 34:             {
 35:                 return BuildImgTag(
 36:                     src: thumbnail.Attribute("url")?.Value,
 37:                     width: thumbnail.Attribute("width")?.Value,
 38:                     height: thumbnail.Attribute("height")?.Value,
 39:                     alt: thumbnail.Attribute("alt")?.Value ?? "Article thumbnail"
 40:                 );
 41:             }
 42: 
 43:             // 2. Prefered <img> inside <description>
 44:             var descriptionHtml = itemElement.Element("description")?.Value;
 45:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(descriptionHtml))
 46:             {
 47:                 var imgFromDesc = ExtractPreferedImgFromHtml(descriptionHtml);
 48:                 if (imgFromDesc != null)
 49:                     return imgFromDesc;
 50:             }
 51: 
 52:             // 3. Prefered <img> inside <contentClean> 
 53:                 var imgFromEncoded = ExtractPreferedImgFromHtml(contentClean);
 54:                 if (imgFromEncoded != null)
 55:                     return imgFromEncoded;
 56: 
 57:             // 4. media:content (only reached if needed)
 58:             var mediaContent = itemElement.Element(MediaNs + "content");
 59:             if (mediaContent != null)
 60:             {
 61:                 return BuildImgTag(
 62:                     src: mediaContent.Attribute("url")?.Value,
 63:                     width: mediaContent.Attribute("width")?.Value,
 64:                     height: mediaContent.Attribute("height")?.Value,
 65:                     alt: mediaContent.Attribute("alt")?.Value ?? "Article image"
 66:                 );
 67:             }
 68: 
 69:             // 5. Eny <img> inside <description>
 70:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(descriptionHtml))
 71:             {
 72:                 var imgFromDesc = ExtractEnyImgFromHtml(descriptionHtml);
 73:                 if (imgFromDesc != null)
 74:                     return imgFromDesc;
 75:             }
 76: 
 77:             // 6. Eny <img> inside <contentClean> 
 78:                 imgFromEncoded = ExtractEnyImgFromHtml(contentClean);
 79:                 if (imgFromEncoded != null)
 80:                     return imgFromEncoded;
 81: 
 82:             _logger.LogWarning("No thumbnail image tag extracted for current article.");
 83:             return null;
 84:         }
 85:         catch (Exception ex)
 86:         {
 87:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error durring image tag extracting");
 88:             return null;
 89:         }
 90:         }
 91: 
 92: 
 93:     private static string? ExtractImgFromHtml(string? html, string xpathQuery)
 94:     {
 95:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html))
 96:             return null;
 97: 
 98:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
 99:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
100: 
101:         var images = doc.DocumentNode.SelectNodes(xpathQuery);
102: 
103:         var img = images
104:             ?.OrderBy(node =>
105:             {
106:                 var heightAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("height", "");
107:                 var widthAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("width", "");
108: 
109:                 var height = int.TryParse(heightAttr, out var h) ? h : int.MaxValue;
110:                 var width = int.TryParse(widthAttr, out var w) ? w : int.MaxValue;
111: 
112:                 return height == int.MaxValue || width == int.MaxValue ? int.MaxValue : height / (double)width;
113:             })
114:             .FirstOrDefault();
115: 
116:         if (img == null)
117:             return null;
118: 
119:         return BuildImgTag(
120:             src: img.GetAttributeValue("src", ""),
121:             width: img.GetAttributeValue("width", ""),
122:             height: img.GetAttributeValue("height", ""),
123:             alt: img.GetAttributeValue("alt", "Article image"),
124:             srcset: img.GetAttributeValue("srcset", ""),
125:             sizes: img.GetAttributeValue("sizes", "")
126:         );
127:     }
128: 
129:     private static string? ExtractPreferedImgFromHtml(string? html)
130:     => ExtractImgFromHtml(html, "//img[not(@slot) and @srcset]");
131: 
132:     private static string? ExtractEnyImgFromHtml(string? html)
133:         => ExtractImgFromHtml(html, "//img");
134: 
135:     // ===================================================================
136:     // CleanSrcsetForPreview - FIXED: properly handles commas inside URLs
137:     // ===================================================================
138:     private static string? CleanSrcsetForPreview(string? srcset)
139:     {
140:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(srcset))
141:             return null;
142: 
143:         // Matches: URL + optional descriptor (e.g. "300w")
144:         var matches = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Matches(
145:             srcset,
146:             @"(?<url>\S+)(?:\s+(?<w>\d+)w)?"
147:         );
148: 
149:         var candidates = new List<(string url, int? width)>();
150: 
151:         foreach (System.Text.RegularExpressions.Match match in matches)
152:         {
153:             var url = match.Groups["url"].Value;
154:             int? width = null;
155: 
156:             if (match.Groups["w"].Success &&
157:                 int.TryParse(match.Groups["w"].Value, out var w))
158:             {
159:                 width = w;
160:             }
161: 
162:             // Skip garbage matches
163:             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(url) || !url.StartsWith("http"))
164:                 continue;
165: 
166:             candidates.Add((url, width));
167:         }
168: 
169:         if (candidates.Count == 0)
170:             return null;
171: 
172:         var maxWidth = GetPreferredMaxWidth(candidates);
173: 
174:         var filtered = candidates
175:             .Where(c => !c.width.HasValue || c.width <= maxWidth)
176:             .OrderBy(c => c.width ?? int.MaxValue)
177:             .ToList();
178: 
179:         // Fallback: if nothing <= 1024, take smallest available
180:         if (filtered.Count == 0)
181:         {
182:             var smallest = candidates
183:                 .Where(c => c.width.HasValue)
184:                 .OrderBy(c => c.width)
185:                 .FirstOrDefault();
186: 
187:             if (smallest.url != null)
188:                 filtered.Add(smallest);
189:         }
190: 
191:         return filtered.Count > 0
192:             ? string.Join(", ", filtered.Select(c =>
193:                 c.width.HasValue ? $"{c.url} {c.width}w" : c.url))
194:             : null;
195:     }
196: 
197:     // ===================================================================
198:     // BuildImgTag - Simplified and safe for previews
199:     // ===================================================================
200:     private static string? BuildImgTag(
201:         string? src = "",
202:         string? width = "",
203:         string? height = "",
204:         string? alt = "",
205:         string? srcset = "",
206:         string? sizes = "")
207:     {
208:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(src))
209:             return null;
210: 
211:         alt ??= "Article image";
212: 
213:         // Clean and limit srcset
214:         srcset = CleanSrcsetForPreview(srcset);
215: 
216:         // Force safe sizes for card previews
217:         sizes = "(max-width: 576px) 100vw, (max-width: 992px) 80vw, 805px";
218: 
219:         var sb = new StringBuilder();
220: 
221:         var bestSrc = PickBestSrcFromSrcset(srcset) ?? src;
222: 
223:         sb.Append($"<img src=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(bestSrc)}\" ");
224: 
225:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(width))
226:         {
227:             sb.Append($"width=\"{width}\" ");
228:         }
229: 
230:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(height))
231:         {
232:             sb.Append($"height=\"{height}\" ");
233:         }
234: 
235:         sb.Append("class=\"img-fluid w-100 rounded mb-3\" ");
236:         sb.Append($"alt=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(alt)}\" ");
237: 
238:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(srcset))
239:         {
240:             sb.Append($"srcset=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(srcset)}\" ");
241:             sb.Append($"sizes=\"{WebUtility.HtmlEncode(sizes)}\" ");
242:         }
243: 
244:         sb.Append("/>");
245:         return sb.ToString();
246:     }
247: 
248:     private static string? PickBestSrcFromSrcset(string? srcset, int targetWidth = 805)
249:     {
250:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(srcset))
251:             return null;
252: 
253:         var matches = System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex.Matches(
254:             srcset,
255:             @"(?<url>\S+)(?:\s+(?<w>\d+)w)?"
256:         );
257: 
258:         var candidates = new List<(string url, int width)>();
259: 
260:         foreach (System.Text.RegularExpressions.Match match in matches)
261:         {
262:             if (!match.Groups["w"].Success)
263:                 continue;
264: 
265:             if (int.TryParse(match.Groups["w"].Value, out var w))
266:             {
267:                 var url = match.Groups["url"].Value;
268:                 candidates.Add((url, w));
269:             }
270:         }
271: 
272:         if (candidates.Count == 0)
273:             return null;
274: 
275:         return candidates
276:             .OrderBy(c => Math.Abs(c.width - targetWidth))
277:             .First()
278:             .url;
279:     }
280: 
281:     private static int GetPreferredMaxWidth(List<(string url, int? width)> candidates)
282:     {
283:         var widths = candidates
284:             .Where(c => c.width.HasValue)
285:             .Select(c => c.width!.Value)
286:             .OrderBy(w => w)
287:             .ToList();
288: 
289:         if (widths.Count == 0)
290:             return 805;
291: 
292:         bool hasPng = candidates.Any(c =>
293:             c.url.Contains(".png", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
294: 
295:         // Ideal preview range
296:         int target = hasPng ? 600 : 805;
297: 
298:         // Pick closest available width ABOVE target (not below → avoid blur)
299:         var best = widths.FirstOrDefault(w => w >= target);
300: 
301:         if (best != 0)
302:             return best;
303: 
304:         // fallback → largest available (if all smaller)
305:         return widths.Last();
306:     }
307: }

File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedItemValidator.cs
================
 1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
 2: using System.Net;
 3: using System.Xml.Linq;
 4: 
 5: public class FeedItemValidator : IFeedItemValidator
 6: {
 7:     private static readonly XNamespace ContentNs = "http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/";
 8:     private static readonly XNamespace DcNs = "http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/";
 9: 
10:     public bool IsValid(XElement itemElement) //TODO: Additional validation
11:     {
12:        var fields = new[] { "title", "link", "description", ContentNs + "encoded" };
13: 
14:         if (fields.Any(t => string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(itemElement.Element(t)?.Value)))
15:             return false;
16: 
17:         if (itemElement.Element(DcNs + "creator")?.Value == "tinybuddha")
18:             return false;
19: 
20:         var html = itemElement.Element(ContentNs + "encoded")!.Value;
21: 
22:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
23:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
24: 
25:         if (doc.DocumentNode == null ||
26:             doc.DocumentNode.InnerHtml == null ||
27:             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(doc.DocumentNode.InnerText) ||
28:             (doc.DocumentNode.InnerText.Length < 25))
29:         {
30:             return false;
31:         }
32: 
33:         return true;
34:     }
35: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedProcessor.cs
================
  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  5: using System.Xml.Linq;
  6: 
  7: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
  8: 
  9: public class FeedProcessor : IFeedProcessor
 10: {
 11:     private readonly ILogger<FeedProcessor> _logger;
 12:     private readonly IFeedItemValidator _validator;
 13:     private readonly IFeedItemParser _parser;
 14:     private readonly IFeedItemCleaner _cleaner;
 15:     private readonly IImgTagExtractor _imgTagExtractor;
 16: 
 17:     public FeedProcessor(IFeedItemValidator validator,
 18:                          IFeedItemParser parser,
 19:                          IFeedItemCleaner cleaner,
 20:                          ILogger<FeedProcessor> loger, 
 21:                          IImgTagExtractor imgTagExtractor)
 22:     {
 23:         _validator = validator;
 24:         _parser = parser;
 25:         _cleaner = cleaner;
 26:         _imgTagExtractor = imgTagExtractor;
 27:         _logger = loger;
 28:     }
 29: 
 30:     public IReadOnlyList<RssFeedItemDto> ProcessFeed(string feedUrl, XDocument feed, out int invalidCount)
 31:     {
 32:         var dtoItems = new List<RssFeedItemDto>();
 33:         invalidCount = 0;
 34: 
 35:         try
 36:         {
 37:             _logger.LogInformation("Processing RSS feed from {FeedUrl}", feedUrl);
 38: 
 39:             var feedItems = feed.Descendants("item").ToList();
 40: 
 41:             if (feedItems is null)
 42:             {
 43:                 _logger.LogWarning("Feed at {FeedUrl} returned null after parsing.", feedUrl);
 44:                 return dtoItems;
 45:             }
 46:             _logger.LogInformation("Found {Count} items in RSS feed.", feedItems.Count);
 47: 
 48:             foreach (var feedItem in feedItems)
 49:             {
 50:                 try
 51:                 {
 52:                     if (!_validator.IsValid(feedItem))
 53:                     {
 54:                         _logger.LogWarning("Skipping invalid feed item.");
 55:                         invalidCount++;
 56:                         continue;
 57:                     }
 58: 
 59:                     var dtoItem = _parser.Parse(feedItem);
 60: 
 61:                     _cleaner.Clean(dtoItem);
 62: 
 63:                     if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dtoItem.ContentRaw))
 64:                         continue;
 65: 
 66:                     dtoItem.ImageTag = _imgTagExtractor.ExtractImgTag(feedItem, dtoItem.ContentRaw);
 67: 
 68:                     if (!ContainsHeroImage(dtoItem.ContentRaw) &&
 69:                         !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dtoItem.ImageTag))
 70:                     {
 71:                         dtoItem.ContentRaw = string.Concat(dtoItem.ImageTag, dtoItem.ContentRaw);
 72:                     }
 73:                     
 74:                     dtoItems.Add(dtoItem);
 75:                 }
 76:                 catch (Exception ex)
 77:                 {
 78:                     _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error parsing RSS feed item");
 79:                     invalidCount++;
 80:                 }
 81: 
 82:                 _logger.LogInformation("Feed item No.{Count} has been successfully processed.", dtoItems.Count);
 83:             }
 84:         }
 85:         catch (Exception ex)
 86:         {
 87:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Failed to process RSS feed from {FeedUrl}", feedUrl);
 88:         }
 89: 
 90:         return dtoItems;
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     private bool ContainsHeroImage(string html)
 94:     {
 95:         try
 96:         {
 97:             var doc = new HtmlDocument();
 98:             doc.LoadHtml(html);
 99: 
100:             var images = doc.DocumentNode.SelectNodes("//img");
101: 
102:             if (images == null || images.Count == 0)
103:                 return false;
104: 
105:             return images.Any(img =>
106:             {
107:                 var classAttr = img.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
108:                 return classAttr.Contains("img-fluid", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) &&
109:                        classAttr.Contains("w-100", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
110:             });
111:         }
112:         catch (Exception ex)
113:         {
114:             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Error checking for fluid images in HTML content");
115:             return false;
116:         }
117:     }
118: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedItemParser.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
 2: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
 3: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 5: using System.Xml.Linq;
 6: 
 7: public class FeedItemParser : IFeedItemParser
 8: {
 9:     private readonly ILogger<FeedReader> _logger;
10:     
11:     private static readonly XNamespace DcNs = "http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/";
12:     private static readonly XNamespace ContentNs = "http://purl.org/rss/1.0/modules/content/";
13: 
14:     public FeedItemParser(ILogger<FeedReader> logger, IImgTagExtractor imgTagextractor)
15:     {
16:         _logger = logger;
17:     }
18:     public RssFeedItemDto Parse(XElement itemElement)
19:     {
20:         return new RssFeedItemDto
21:         {
22:             Title = itemElement.Element("title")!.Value,              // "!" is because validator guarantees it exists.
23:             Link = itemElement.Element("link")!.Value,   
24:             Description = itemElement.Element("description")!.Value,
25:             ContentRaw = itemElement.Element(ContentNs + "encoded")!.Value,
26:             Author = itemElement.Element(DcNs + "creator")?.Value,    
27:             PublishedDate = ParseDate(itemElement),
28:             Topics = ExtractCategories(itemElement),
29:             ExternalId = itemElement.Element("guid")?.Value           //TODO: Add cleaner/cutter and regex conductor before parsing. Like in methods bellow
30:         };
31:     }
32: 
33:     /// <summary>
34:     /// Extracts all category tags as topics
35:     /// Returns list of category values, or ["Default"] if none found
36:     /// </summary>
37:     private List<string> ExtractCategories(XElement itemElement)
38:     {
39:         var categories = itemElement
40:             .Elements("category")
41:             .Select(c => c.Value)
42:             .Where(v => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(v))
43:             .Distinct()
44:             .ToList();
45: 
46:         // If no categories found, return default
47:         if (categories == null || categories.Count == 0)
48:         {
49:             categories = ["Default"];
50:             _logger.LogDebug("No categories found, using default");
51:         }
52: 
53:         _logger.LogDebug("Extracted categories: {Categories}", string.Join(", ", categories));
54: 
55:         return categories;
56:     }
57: 
58:     private static DateTime ParseDate(XElement item)
59:     {
60:         var dateStr = item.Element("pubDate")?.Value?.Trim();
61: 
62:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dateStr))
63:         {
64:             // Common RSS date formats
65:             string[] formats = new[]
66:             {
67:             "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss zzz",
68:             "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss K",
69:             "ddd, dd MMM yyyy HH:mm:ss",
70:             "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:sszzz",
71:             "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssK",
72:             "yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss"
73:             };
74: 
75:             if (DateTime.TryParseExact(dateStr, formats,
76:                 System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
77:                 System.Globalization.DateTimeStyles.None, out var result))
78:             {
79:                 return result;
80:             }
81:             // Try standard parse as fallback
82:             if (DateTime.TryParse(dateStr, out result))
83:             {
84:                 return result;
85:             }
86:         }
87:         return DateTime.UtcNow;
88:     }
89: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/DependencyInjection.cs
================
 1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
 2: using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
 3: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
 4: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
 5: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.BackgroundJobs;
 6: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence;
 7: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 8: 
 9: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure;
10: 
11: /// <summary>
12: /// Clean Registration Pattern for the Infrastructure layer.
13: /// Call this single method from WebApi's Program.cs.
14: /// </summary>
15: public static class DependencyInjection
16: {
17:     public static IServiceCollection AddInfrastructureServices(
18:         this IServiceCollection services, IConfiguration configuration)
19:     {
20:         // EF Core with SQL Server
21:         var connectionString = ConnectionStringResolver.Resolve(configuration);
22: 
23:         services.AddDbContext<AppDbContext>(options =>
24:                options.UseSqlServer(connectionString, sqlOptions =>
25:                       {
26:                           sqlOptions.MigrationsAssembly(typeof(AppDbContext).Assembly.FullName);
27:                           sqlOptions.EnableRetryOnFailure(maxRetryCount: 3);
28:                       }));
29: 
30:         // HttpClient for RSS feed fetching.
31:         // Configured with a polite User-Agent and a reasonable timeout.
32:         services.AddHttpClient("RssFeedClient", client =>
33:      {
34:          client.Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(30);
35:          client.DefaultRequestHeaders.UserAgent.ParseAdd(
36:             "PositiveNews/1.0 (+https://github.com/positivenews; Academic Project)");
37:          client.DefaultRequestHeaders.Accept.ParseAdd("application/rss+xml, application/xml, text/xml");
38:      });
39: 
40:         // Application services
41:         services.AddScoped<IFeedReader, FeedReader>();
42:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemValidator, FeedItemValidator>();
43:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemParser, FeedItemParser>();
44:         services.AddScoped<IFeedProcessor, FeedProcessor>();
45:         services.AddScoped<IFeedItemCleaner, FeedItemCleaner>();
46:         services.AddScoped<IIngestionService, IngestionService>();
47:         services.AddScoped<IImgTagExtractor, ImgTagExtractor>();
48: 
49:         // Background services
50:         services.AddHostedService<IngestionBackgroundService>();
51: 
52:         return services;
53:     }
54: }

  1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

  6: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence.Seeding;

  8: /// <summary>
  9: /// Applies migrations (creates DB if missing) and seeds reference data.
 10: /// Designed to be called once at application startup.
 11: /// </summary>
 12: public static class DataSeeder
 13: {
 14:     public static async Task SeedAsync(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
 15:     {
 16:         using var scope = serviceProvider.CreateScope();
 17:         var context = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
 18:         var logger = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<ILogger<AppDbContext>>();
 19: 
 20:         logger.LogInformation("Applying database migrations (will create DB if it does not exist)...");
 21:         await context.Database.MigrateAsync();
 22:         logger.LogInformation("Database migrations applied successfully.");
 23: 
 24:         await SeedRolesAsync(context, logger);
 25:         await SeedTopicsAsync(context, logger);
 26:         await SeedSourcesAsync(context, logger);
 27:         await SeedAdminUserAsync(context, logger);
 28:     }
 29: 
 30:     private static async Task SeedRolesAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger logger)
 31:     {
 32:         if (await context.Roles.AnyAsync()) return;
 33: 
 34:         var roles = new List<Role>
 35:         {
 36:             new() { Name = "Admin" },
 37:             new() { Name = "Moderator" },
 38:             new() { Name = "User" }
 39:         };
 40: 
 41:         context.Roles.AddRange(roles);
 42:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
 43:         logger.LogInformation("Seeded {Count} roles.", roles.Count);
 44:     }
 45: 
 46:     private static async Task SeedTopicsAsync(AppDbContext context, ILogger logger)
 47:     {
 48:         if (await context.Topics.AnyAsync()) return;
 49: 
 50:         var topics = new List<Topic>
 51:         {
 52:             new() { Name = "Default",          Slug = "default",          Description = "Not categorized" },
 53:             new() { Name = "Technology",       Slug = "technology",       Description = "Tech innovations and digital trends" },
 54:             new() { Name = "Health",           Slug = "health",           Description = "Wellness, medicine, and health science" },
 55:             new() { Name = "Science",          Slug = "science",          Description = "Scientific discoveries and research" },
 56:             new() { Name = "Environment",      Slug = "environment",      Description = "Climate, ecology, and conservation" },
 57:             new() { Name = "Space",            Slug = "space",            Description = "Astronomy, space exploration, and NASA" },
 58:             new() { Name = "Travel",           Slug = "travel",           Description = "Destinations, culture, and adventure" },
 59:             new() { Name = "Animals",          Slug = "animals",          Description = "Wildlife and animal stories" },
 60:             new() { Name = "Inspiring",        Slug = "inspiring",        Description = "Uplifting and motivational stories" },
 61:             new() { Name = "Arts & Culture",   Slug = "arts-culture",     Description = "Art, music, literature, and culture" },
 62:             new() { Name = "Education",        Slug = "education",        Description = "Learning, teaching, and academic breakthroughs" },
 63:             new() { Name = "Business",         Slug = "business",         Description = "Economy, startups, and corporate responsibility" },
 64:             new() { Name = "Sports",           Slug = "sports",           Description = "Athletic achievements and sports news" },
 65:             new() { Name = "General",          Slug = "general",          Description = "Uncategorized positive news" }
 66:         };
 67:

 69:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
 70:         logger.LogInformation("Seeded {Count} topics.", topics.Count);

147:     {
148:         if (await context.Users.AnyAsync()) return;
149: 
150:         // Seed a system/admin user to own future moderation actions.
151:         // In production, the password hash would come from a proper Identity hasher.
152:         var adminUser = new User
153:         {
154:             Email = "admin@positivenews.local",
155:             EmailConfirmed = true,
156:             Name = "System Administrator",
157:             PasswordHash = null, // Will be set via proper Auth flow later.
158:             IsActive = true
159:         };
160: 
161:         context.Users.Add(adminUser);
162:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
163: 
164:         var adminRole = await context.Roles.FirstAsync(r => r.Name == "Admin");
165:         context.UserRoles.Add(new UserRole { UserId = adminUser.Id, RoleId = adminRole.Id });
166:         await context.SaveChangesAsync();
167: 
168:         logger.LogInformation("Seeded admin user '{Email}' with Admin role.", adminUser.Email);
169:     }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/FeedItemCleaner.cs
