  1: using HtmlAgilityPack;
  2: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  3: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  4: using System.Net;
  5: using System.Text;
  6: using System.Text.RegularExpressions;
  7: using static Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.SyntaxTokenParser;
  8: 
  9: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 10: 
 11: public class FeedItemCleaner : IFeedItemCleaner
 12: {
 13:     private static readonly HashSet<string> AllowedTags = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 14:     {
 15:         "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "p", "img", "video", "source", "ul", "ol", "li", "a", "iframe"
 16:     };
 17: 
 18:     private static readonly HashSet<string> AttributesToRemove = new(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
 19:     {
 20:         "class", "style", "block_context"
 21:     };
 22: 
 23:     private static readonly string[] RemoveDivClassPatterns =
 24:     {
 25:         "navigation-menu",
 26:         "blocks-content-lists",
 27:         "hds-featured-file-list",
 28:         "hds-audio-player-",
 29:         "secondary-navigation",
 30:         "comparison-slider-parent",
 31:         "two-up-view",
 32:         "content-lists-inner",
 33:         "topic-cards",
 34:         "twitter-tweet",
 35:         "attachment-medium size-medium wp-post-image" //first image for Design You Trust
 36:     };
 37: 
 38:     // Patterns that trigger "stop processing all following content"
 39:     private static readonly string[] StopProcessingPatterns =
 40:     {
 41:         "About the Author",
 42:         //"For more information about",
 43:         "Discover More Topics From",
 44:         //"For more information on",
 45:         "Click here to leave a comment on the site",
 46:         "Members can also look for the following:",
 47:         "What are you planning to play this weekend?",
 48:         "in the comments below.",
 49:         "-end-"
 50:     };
 51: 
 52:     // Patterns that trigger removal of a single node
 53:     private static readonly string[] RemoveNodePatterns =
 54:     {
 55:     "Learn more about this image",
 56:      "To learn more about",
 57:     "Listen to this audio",
 58:     "follow us on",
 59:     "Donate link:",
 60:     "The Optimist Daily is a project of the World Business Academy",
 61:     "Subscribe to our",
 62:     "Want to be part of the Optimism Movement?",
 63:     "If you have questions, comments, feedback, suggestions, or just want to say hi, send a message to:"
 64:     };
 65: 
 66:     private static readonly Regex YoutubeRegex = new(
 67:     @"(?:https?://)?(?:www\.)?(?:youtube\.com/watch\?v=|youtu\.be/|youtube\.com/embed/)([a-zA-Z0-9_-]{11})",
 68:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 69: 
 70:     private static readonly Regex StrongTildeRegex = new(
 71:     @"<strong>\s*(?<left>[^~<]+?)\s*~\s*[^<]*\s*</strong>",
 72:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 73: 
 74:     private static readonly Regex AppearedFirstOnRegex = new(
 75:     @"<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\s*appeared first on\s*<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\.?",
 76:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 77: 
 78:     private static readonly Regex OptimistEditorialRegex = new(
 79:     @"BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY(?:’S|'S)? EDITORIAL TEAM",
 80:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled);
 81: 
 82:     private static readonly Regex ThePostRegex = new(
 83:     @"The post\s*<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\s*first appeared on\s*<a[^>]*>.*?<\/a>\.?",
 84:     RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled | RegexOptions.Singleline);
 85: 
 86:     public void Clean(RssFeedItemDto dto)
 87:     {
 88:         dto.Description = CleanDescription(dto.Description);
 89:         dto.ContentRaw = CleanContent(dto.ContentRaw);  
 90:         dto.Title = CleanTitle(dto.Title);
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     private static string CleanContent(string rawContent)
 94:     {
 95:         var doc = LoadDocument(rawContent);
 96:         var builder = new StringBuilder();
 97:         var stopProcessing = false;
 98: 
 99:         ProcessNodesRecursively(doc.DocumentNode, builder, ref stopProcessing);
100: 
101:         var cleaned = RemoveTrailingPostLinks(builder.ToString());
102:         return RemoveTildeAuthor(cleaned).Trim();  
103:     }
104: 
105:     private static HtmlDocument LoadDocument(string html)
106:     {
107:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
108:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
109:         return doc;
110:     }
111: 
112:     private static void ProcessNodesRecursively(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
113:     {
114:         foreach (var child in node.ChildNodes)
115:         {
116:             if (stopProcessing)
117:                 return;
118: 
119:             if (child.NodeType != HtmlNodeType.Element)
120:                 continue;
121: 
122:             // Check for stop-processing triggers first
123:             if (ShouldStopProcessing(child))
124:             {
125:                 stopProcessing = true;
126:                 return;
127:             }
128: 
129:             // Check if node should be skipped entirely
130:             if (ShouldRemoveNode(child))
131:                 continue;
132: 
133:             var tagName = child.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
134: 
135:             // Handle special div transformations
136:             if (tagName == "div")
137:             {
138:                 ProcessDiv(child, builder, ref stopProcessing);
139:                 continue;
140:             }
141: 
142:             // Handle anchor tags (check for YouTube links)
143:             if (tagName == "a")
144:             {
145:                 ProcessAnchor(child, builder, ref stopProcessing);
146:                 continue;
147:             }
148: 
149:             // Handle lists with wp-block-list class
150:             if ((tagName == "ul" || tagName == "ol") && HasClassContaining(child, "wp-block-list"))
151:             {
152:                 ProcessList(child, builder);
153:                 continue;
154:             }
155: 
156:             if (AllowedTags.Contains(tagName))
157:             {
158:                 ProcessAllowedNode(child, tagName, builder, ref stopProcessing);
159:             }
160:             else
161:             {
162:                 // Recursively process children of non-allowed tags
163:                 ProcessNodesRecursively(child, builder, ref stopProcessing);
164:             }
165:         }
166:     }
167: 
168:     private static void ProcessDiv(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
169:     {
170:         // Check if div should be removed by class
171:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveDivClassPatterns)
172:         {
173:             if (HasClassContaining(node, pattern))
174:                 return;
175:         }
176: 
177:         // Transform hds-caption-text divs to small italic paragraph
178:         if (HasClassContaining(node, "hds-caption-text"))
179:         {
180:             var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
181:             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
182:             {
183:                 builder.AppendLine($"<p class=\"small fst-italic\">{System.Net.WebUtility.HtmlEncode(text)}</p>");
184:             }
185:             return;
186:         }
187: 
188:         // Otherwise, process children of the div
189:         ProcessNodesRecursively(node, builder, ref stopProcessing);
190:     }
191: 
192:     private static void ProcessAnchor(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
193:     {
194:         var href = node.GetAttributeValue("href", "");
195: 
196:         // Check if it's a YouTube link
197:         var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(href);
198:         if (youtubeMatch.Success)
199:         {
200:             var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
201:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
202:             return;
203:         }
204: 
205:         // Check for YouTube links in the anchor's inner content (nested links)
206:         var innerHtml = node.InnerHtml;
207:         var innerMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(innerHtml);
208:         if (innerMatch.Success)
209:         {
210:             var videoId = innerMatch.Groups[1].Value;
211:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
212:             return;
213:         }
214: 
215:         // Otherwise, process anchor normally (keep it, process children)
216:         ProcessNodesRecursively(node, builder, ref stopProcessing);
217:     }
218: 
219:     private static string CreateYouTubeEmbed(string videoId)
220:     {
221:         return $@"<div class=""ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3"">
222:                 <iframe src=""https://www.youtube.com/embed/{videoId}"" 
223:                 title=""YouTube video"" 
224:                 allow=""accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share"" 
225:                 allowfullscreen>
226:                 </iframe>
227:                 </div>";
228:     }
229: 
230:     private static void ProcessList(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
231:     {
232:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
233:         builder.AppendLine(cleanedNode.OuterHtml);
234:     }
235: 
236:     private static void ProcessAllowedNode(HtmlNode node, string tagName, StringBuilder builder, ref bool stopProcessing)
237:     {
238:         switch (tagName)
239:         {
240:             case "p":
241:                 ProcessParagraph(node, builder);
242:                 break;
243: 
244:             case "h1":
245:             case "h2":
246:             case "h3":
247:             case "h4":
248:                 ProcessHeader(node, builder);
249:                 break;
250: 
251:             case "img":
252:                 ProcessImage(node, builder);
253:                 break;
254: 
255:             case "video":
256:                 ProcessVideo(node, builder);
257:                 break;
258: 
259:             case "ul":
260:             case "ol":
261:                 ProcessList(node, builder);
262:                 break;
263: 
264:             case "li":
265:                 ProcessListItem(node, builder);
266:                 break;
267: 
268:             case "iframe":
269:                 ProcessIframe(node, builder);
270:                 break;
271:         }
272:     }
273: 
274:     private static void ProcessParagraph(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
275:     {
276:         // Check for YouTube iframes FIRST and extract them
277:         var iframes = node.SelectNodes(".//iframe");
278:         if (iframes != null)
279:         {
280:             foreach (var iframe in iframes)
281:             {
282:                 var src = iframe.GetAttributeValue("src", "");
283:                 var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(src);
284:                 if (youtubeMatch.Success)
285:                 {
286:                     var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
287:                     builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
288:                 }
289:             }
290:         }
291: 
292:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
293: 
294:         // Include iframe in media check
295:         var hasMedia = node.SelectNodes(".//img | .//video | .//iframe") != null;
296:         var hasText = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text);
297: 
298:         // If paragraph ONLY contained iframe (already processed above), skip outputting empty <p>
299:         if (!hasText && iframes != null && node.SelectNodes(".//img | .//video") == null)
300:             return;
301: 
302:         if (!hasText && !hasMedia)
303:             return;
304: 
305:         if (hasText && ShouldRemoveParagraph(text))
306:             return;
307: 
308:         var images = node.SelectNodes(".//img");
309:         if (images != null)
310:         {
311:             foreach (var img in images.ToList())
312:             {
313:                 var imgBuilder = new StringBuilder();
314:                 ProcessImage(img, imgBuilder);
315: 
316:                 // Replace original <img> with processed one
317:                 var newImgDoc = new HtmlDocument();
318:                 newImgDoc.LoadHtml(imgBuilder.ToString());
319:                 var newImg = newImgDoc.DocumentNode.FirstChild;
320:                 img.ParentNode.ReplaceChild(newImg, img);
321:             }
322:         }
323: 
324:         // THEN clean paragraph
325:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
326:         builder.AppendLine(cleanedNode.OuterHtml);
327:     }
328: 
329:     private static void ProcessHeader(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
330:     {
331:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
332: 
333:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
334:             return;
335: 
336:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
337:         builder.AppendLine(cleanedNode.OuterHtml);
338:     }
339: 
340:     private static void ProcessImage(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
341:     {
342:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
343: 
344:         if (classAttr.Contains("attachment-thumbnail size-thumbnail", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)||
345:             classAttr.Contains("wp-biographia-avatar", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
346:             classAttr.Contains("wp-smiley", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||  // ← Add this for emoji
347:             classAttr.Contains("emoji", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
348:         {
349:             // Remove unwanted attributes
350:             var toRemove = node.Attributes
351:                 .Where(attr => AttributesToRemove.Contains(attr.Name))
352:                 .Select(attr => attr.Name)
353:                 .ToList();
354: 
355:             foreach (var attrName in toRemove)
356:                 node.Attributes.Remove(attrName);
357: 
358:             node.SetAttributeValue("class", "img-fluid w-5 rounded mb-3");
359:             builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
360:         }
361:         else
362:         {
363:             // Remove unwanted attributes
364:             var toRemove = node.Attributes
365:                 .Where(attr => AttributesToRemove.Contains(attr.Name))
366:                 .Select(attr => attr.Name)
367:                 .ToList();
368: 
369:             foreach (var attrName in toRemove)
370:                 node.Attributes.Remove(attrName);
371: 
372:             // Standard image styling
373:             node.SetAttributeValue("class", "img-fluid w-100 rounded mb-3");
374:             builder.AppendLine(node.OuterHtml);
375:         }
376:     }
377: 
378:     private static void ProcessVideo(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
379:     {
380:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
381: 
382:         // Add Bootstrap responsive video classes
383:         cleanedNode.SetAttributeValue("class", "w-100 rounded mb-3");
384:         cleanedNode.SetAttributeValue("controls", "");
385: 
386:         var sources = cleanedNode.SelectNodes(".//source");
387:         if (sources != null)
388:         {
389:             foreach (var source in sources)
390:                 CleanAttributesRecursively(source);
391:         }
392: 
393:         // Wrap in responsive container
394:         var videoHtml = cleanedNode.OuterHtml;
395:         builder.AppendLine($"<div class=\"ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3\">{videoHtml}</div>");
396:     }
397: 
398:     private static void ProcessIframe(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
399:     {
400:         var src = node.GetAttributeValue("src", "");
401: 
402:         // Check if it's a YouTube embed
403:         var youtubeMatch = YoutubeRegex.Match(src);
404:         if (youtubeMatch.Success)
405:         {
406:             var videoId = youtubeMatch.Groups[1].Value;
407:             builder.AppendLine(CreateYouTubeEmbed(videoId));
408:             return;
409:         }
410: 
411:         // Generic iframe - wrap in responsive container
412:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
413:         cleanedNode.SetAttributeValue("class", "w-100");
414:         builder.AppendLine($"<div class=\"ratio ratio-16x9 mb-3\">{cleanedNode.OuterHtml}</div>");
415:     }
416: 
417:     private static void ProcessListItem(HtmlNode node, StringBuilder builder)
418:     {
419:         var cleanedNode = CleanAttributes(node);
420:         builder.AppendLine(cleanedNode.OuterHtml);
421:     }
422: 
423:     private static HtmlNode CleanAttributes(HtmlNode original)
424:     {
425:         var clone = original.CloneNode(true);
426:         CleanAttributesRecursively(clone);
427:         return clone;
428:     }
429: 
430:     private static void CleanAttributesRecursively(HtmlNode node)
431:     {
432:         if (node == null || node.Name.Equals("img", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
433:             return;
434: 
435:         if (node.NodeType == HtmlNodeType.Element)
436:         {
437: 
438:             // Remove script tags anywhere in the subtree
439:             var scripts = node.SelectNodes(".//script");
440:             if (scripts != null)
441:             {
442:                 foreach (var script in scripts.ToList())
443:                     script.Remove();
444:             }
445: 
446:             // Remove other non-allowed tags from cloned content
447:             var disallowedTags = node.SelectNodes(".//script | .//style | .//noscript");
448:             if (disallowedTags != null)
449:             {
450:                 foreach (var tag in disallowedTags.ToList())
451:                     tag.Remove();
452:             }
453: 
454:             // Remove unwanted attributes
455:             var toRemove = node.Attributes
456:                 .Where(attr => AttributesToRemove.Contains(attr.Name))
457:                 .Select(attr => attr.Name)
458:                 .ToList();
459: 
460:             foreach (var attrName in toRemove)
461:                 node.Attributes.Remove(attrName);
462:         }
463: 
464:         foreach (var child in node.ChildNodes)
465:         {
466:             CleanAttributesRecursively(child);
467:         }
468:     }
469: 
470:     private static bool HasClassContaining(HtmlNode node, string pattern)
471:     {
472:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
473:         return classAttr.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
474:     }
475: 
476:     private static bool HasExactClass(HtmlNode node, string exactClass)
477:     {
478:         var classAttr = node.GetAttributeValue("class", "");
479:         return classAttr.Equals(exactClass, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
480:     }
481: 
482:     private static bool ShouldStopProcessing(HtmlNode node)
483:     {
484:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText).Trim();
485: 
486:         // Check for single "Share" text
487:         if (text.Equals("Share", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
488:             return true;
489: 
490:         // Check for stop-processing patterns
491:         foreach (var pattern in StopProcessingPatterns)
492:         {
493:             if (text.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
494:                 return true;
495:         }
496: 
497:         return false;
498:     }
499: 
500:     private static bool ShouldRemoveNode(HtmlNode node)
501:     {
502:         var text = HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(node.InnerText);
503: 
504:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveNodePatterns)
505:         {
506:             if (text.Contains(pattern, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
507:                 return true;
508:         }
509: 
510:         var tagName = node.Name.ToLowerInvariant();
511: 
512:        
513:         foreach (var pattern in RemoveDivClassPatterns)
514:         {
515:             if (HasClassContaining(node, pattern))
516:                 return true;
517:         }
518:         
519: 
520:         // Check for thumbnail images
521:         if (tagName == "img" && HasExactClass(node, "attachment-thumbnail size-thumbnail"))
522:             return true;
523: 
524:         // ADD: Always remove script tags
525:         if (tagName == "script")
526:             return true;
527: 
528:         return false;
529:     }
530: 
531:     private static bool ShouldRemoveParagraph(string text)
532:     {
533:         var lower = text.ToLowerInvariant();
534:         return lower.Contains("did this solution stand out")
535:             || lower.Contains("becoming an emissary")
536:             || lower.StartsWith("the post ")
537:             || lower.Contains("appeared first on");
538:     }
539: 
540:     private static string RemoveTrailingPostLinks(string content)
541:     {
542:         return Regex.Replace(
543:             content,
544:             @"<\/p>\s*The post\s*<a.*?<\/a>.*",
545:             "",
546:             RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);
547:     }
548: 
549:     private static string CleanDescription(string description)
550:     {
551:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(description))
552:             return string.Empty;
553: 
554:         // Decode HTML entities first
555:         var html = WebUtility.HtmlDecode(description);
556: 
557:         html = ThePostRegex.Replace(html, "");
558: 
559:         // -------------------------------------------------------
560:         // 1. Remove "~something" inside <strong>
561:         // -------------------------------------------------------
562:         html = StrongTildeRegex.Replace(html, "<strong>${left}</strong>");
563: 
564:         // -------------------------------------------------------
565:         // 2. Remove unwanted editorial paragraph
566:         // -------------------------------------------------------
567:         html = OptimistEditorialRegex.Replace(html, "");
568: 
569:         // -------------------------------------------------------
570:         // 3. Remove "appeared first on Colossal"
571:         // -------------------------------------------------------
572:         html = AppearedFirstOnRegex.Replace(html, "");
573: 
574:         // -------------------------------------------------------
575:         // 4. Parse HTML safely
576:         // -------------------------------------------------------
577:         var doc = new HtmlDocument();
578:         doc.LoadHtml(html);
579: 
580:         var paragraphs = doc.DocumentNode.SelectNodes("//p");
581: 
582:         if (paragraphs == null || paragraphs.Count == 0)
583:             return TrimAfterLastDot(doc.DocumentNode.InnerText);
584: 
585:         var texts = paragraphs
586:     .Select(p => HtmlEntity.DeEntitize(p.InnerText).Trim())
587:     .Where(t => !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(t))
588:     .Where(t =>
589:         !Regex.IsMatch(t, @"appeared first on", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase) &&
590:         !Regex.IsMatch(t, @"BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase) &&
591:         !Regex.IsMatch(t, @"^The post ", RegexOptions.IgnoreCase)
592:     );
593: 
594:         var result = string.Join(" ", texts);
595: 
596:         // Final safety cleanup (text-level)
597:         result = Regex.Replace(
598:             result,
599:             @"The post .*? first appeared on .*?\.",
600:             "",
601:             RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Singleline);
602: 
603:         result = Regex.Replace(
604:             result,
605:             @"BY THE OPTIMIST DAILY.*?(?=\.)",
606:             "",
607:             RegexOptions.IgnoreCase);
608: 
609:         result = result.Length > 1999 ? result[..1999] : result;
610: 
611:         // -------------------------------------------------------
612:         // 5. Trim everything after last dot
613:         // -------------------------------------------------------
614:         return TrimAfterLastDot(result);
615:     }
616: 
617:     private static string TrimAfterLastDot(string text)
618:     {
619:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(text))
620:             return text;
621: 
622:         var lastDotIndex = text.LastIndexOf('.');
623: 
624:         if (lastDotIndex > 0)
625:             return text.Substring(0, lastDotIndex + 1).Trim();
626: 
627:         return text.Trim();
628:     }
629: 
630:     private static string CleanTitle(string title)
631:     {
632:         return title.Length > 500 ? title[..500] : title;
633:     }
634: 
635:     private static string RemoveTildeAuthor(string html)
636:     {
637:         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(html))
638:             return html;
639: 
640:         return Regex.Replace(
641:             html,
642:             @"<strong>\s*(?<left>[^~<]+?)\s*~\s*[^<]*\s*</strong>",
643:             "<strong>${left}</strong>",
644:             RegexOptions.IgnoreCase | RegexOptions.Compiled
645:         );
646:     }
647: 
648: 
649: }

================
File: src/PositiveNews.Infrastructure/Services/IngestionService.cs
================
  1: using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;
  2: using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
  3: using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
  4: using PositiveNews.Application.DTOs;
  5: using PositiveNews.Application.Interfaces;
  6: using PositiveNews.Domain.Entities;
  7: using PositiveNews.Domain.Enums;
  8: using PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Persistence;
  9: using System.Security.Cryptography;
 10: using static System.Runtime.InteropServices.JavaScript.JSType;
 11: 
 12: namespace PositiveNews.Infrastructure.Services;
 13: 
 14: /// <summary>
 15: /// Iterates over all active sources, fetches their RSS feeds, 
 16: /// deduplicates against existing articles, and persists new ones.
 17: /// </summary>
 18: public class IngestionService : IIngestionService
 19: {
 20: 
 21:     private readonly IServiceScopeFactory _scopeFactory;
 22:     // Each source gets its own DbContext scope, which prevents stale tracking and memory bloat.
 23:     // This follows Microsoft's recommended pattern for consuming scoped services from hosted services.
 24:     private readonly IFeedReader _feedReader;
 25:     private readonly IFeedProcessor _feedProcessor;
 26:     private readonly ILogger<IngestionService> _logger;
 27: 
 28:     /// <summary>
 29:     /// Polite delay between processing individual sources to avoid hammering external servers.
 30:     /// </summary>
 31:     private static readonly TimeSpan DelayBetweenSources = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2); //TODO - These can be made configurable.
 32: 
 33:     public IngestionService(
 34:         IServiceScopeFactory scopeFactory,
 35:         IFeedReader feedReader, IFeedProcessor feedProcessor,
 36:         ILogger<IngestionService> logger)
 37:     {
 38:         _scopeFactory = scopeFactory;
 39:         _feedReader = feedReader;
 40:         _feedProcessor = feedProcessor;
 41:         _logger = logger;
 42:     }
 43: 
 44:     public async Task RunIngestionCycleAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
 45:     {
 46:         _logger.LogInformation("=== Ingestion cycle started. ===");
 47: 
 48:         // Fetch the list of active sources.
 49:         List<Source> activeSources;
 50:         using (var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope())
 51:         {
 52:             var context = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
 53:             activeSources = await context.Sources
 54:                 .Where(s => s.IsActive && s.FeedUrl != null)
 55:                 .AsNoTracking()
 56:                 .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
 57:         }
 58: 
 59:         _logger.LogInformation("Found {Count} active sources with feed URLs.", activeSources.Count);
 60: 
 61:         foreach (var source in activeSources)
 62:         {
 63:             if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) break;
 64: 
 65:             await ProcessSourceAsync(source, cancellationToken);
 66: 
 67:             // Polite delay between sources.
 68:             if (!cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested)
 69:             {
 70:                 _logger.LogDebug("Waiting {Delay} before next source...", DelayBetweenSources);
 71:                 await Task.Delay(DelayBetweenSources, cancellationToken);
 72:             }
 73:         }
 74: 
 75:         _logger.LogInformation("=== Ingestion cycle completed. ===");
 76:     }
 77: 
 78:     private async Task ProcessSourceAsync(Source source, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
 79:     {
 80:         _logger.LogInformation("Processing source: {SourceName} ({FeedUrl})", source.Name, source.FeedUrl);
 81: 
 82:         // Create a fresh scope (and therefore a fresh DbContext) for each source.
 83:         using var scope = _scopeFactory.CreateScope();
 84:         var context = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<AppDbContext>();
 85: 
 86:         var run = new IngestionRun
 87:         {
 88:             SourceId = source.Id,
 89:             StartedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
 90:             Status = IngestionStatus.Running
 91:         };
 92:         context.IngestionRuns.Add(run);
 93:         await context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
 94: 
 95:         int newArticleCount = 0;
 96:         var url = source.FeedUrl!;
 97: 
 98:         try
 99:         {
100:             var doc = await _feedReader.ReadFeedAsync(url, cancellationToken);
101: 
102:             var dtoItems = _feedProcessor.ProcessFeed(url, doc, out int invalidCount);
103: 
104:             if (dtoItems.Count == 0)
105:             {
106:                 _logger.LogWarning("Source {SourceName} returned zero feed items.", source.Name);
107:                 run.Status = IngestionStatus.Partial;
108:                 run.ErrorMessage = "Feed returned zero items. The feed URL may be unavailable or empty.";
109:                 run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
110:                 await context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
111:                 return;
112:             }
113: 
114:             foreach (var item in dtoItems)
115:             {
116:                 cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
117: 
118:                 try
119:                 {
120:                     if (await IsAlreadyExists(item, context, cancellationToken))
121:                     {
122:                         _logger.LogDebug("Skipping duplicate: {Title}", item.Title);
123:                         continue;
124:                     }
125: 
126:                     TakeArticleData(source, item, context);
127: 
128:                     newArticleCount++;
129:                     _logger.LogInformation("Ingested new article: {Title}", item.Title);
130:                 }
131:                 catch (Exception ex) when (ex is not OperationCanceledException)
132:                 {
133:                     _logger.LogError(ex, "Error processing DTO for article: {ExternalId}", item.ExternalId);
134:                 }
135:             }
136:             run.Status = IngestionStatus.Success;
137:             run.ItemsFetched = newArticleCount;
138:             run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
139:             await context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);
140: 
141:             _logger.LogInformation(
142:                 "Source {SourceName}: ingested {NewCount} new articles out of {TotalCount} feed items. {InvalidCount} rejected.",
143:                 source.Name, newArticleCount, dtoItems.Count+invalidCount, invalidCount);
144:         }
145:         catch (OperationCanceledException)
146:         {
147:             _logger.LogWarning("Ingestion for {SourceName} was cancelled.", source.Name);
148:             run.Status = IngestionStatus.Partial;
149:             run.ErrorMessage = "Operation was cancelled.";
150:             run.ItemsFetched = newArticleCount;
151:             run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
152:             await context.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None); // Save even on cancellation.
153:         }
154:         catch (Exception ex)
155:         {
156:             _logger.LogError(ex, "Error ingesting source {SourceName}.", source.Name);
157:             run.Status = IngestionStatus.Failed;
158:             run.ErrorMessage = ex.Message.Length > 4000 ? ex.Message[..4000] : ex.Message;
159:             run.ItemsFetched = newArticleCount;
160:             run.FinishedAt = DateTime.UtcNow;
161:             await context.SaveChangesAsync(CancellationToken.None);
162:         }
163:     }
164: 
165:     private static async Task<bool> IsAlreadyExists(RssFeedItemDto dto, AppDbContext context,
166:                                                     CancellationToken cancellationToken)
167:     {
168:         bool alreadyExists = false;
169: 
170:         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.ExternalId))
171:         {
172:             alreadyExists = await context.ArticlesMetadata
173:                 .AnyAsync(a => a.ExternalId == dto.ExternalId, cancellationToken);
174:         }
175: 
176:         if (!alreadyExists && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(dto.Link))
177:         {
178:             alreadyExists = await context.ArticlesMetadata
179:                 .AnyAsync(a => a.Url == dto.Link, cancellationToken);
180:         }
181: 
182:         return alreadyExists;
183:     }
184: 
185:     private static void TakeArticleData(Source source, RssFeedItemDto dto, AppDbContext context)
186:     {
187:         var articleMeta = new ArticleMetadata
188:         {
189:             SourceId = source.Id,
190:             ExternalId = dto.ExternalId,
191:             Title = dto.Title,
192:             Author = dto.Author,
193:             Url = dto.Link,
194:             ImageTag = dto.ImageTag,
195:             PublishedAt = dto.PublishedDate,
196:             IngestedAt = DateTime.UtcNow,
197:             LanguageCode = source.DefaultLanguageCode,
198:             RegionCode = "Global",
199:             IsActive = true,
200:             SummaryShort = dto.Description
201:         };
202: 
203:         var articleContent = new ArticleContent
204:         {
205:             ContentRaw = dto.ContentRaw,
206:         };
207: 
208:         articleMeta.Content = articleContent;
209: 
210:         context.ArticlesMetadata.Add(articleMeta);
211:     }
212: }
